The --infeasible file of servtuner propose: the boot probes made so far, each a deployment with no load. An infeasible result rules out every configuration whose knobs contain its knobs. A feasible result must name every feasibility knob of the search space; its c\_kv, below the space's min\_concurrency, drops the configuration. The probe of a combination is the base knobs plus the feasibility knobs' values.

Schema file: `schema/json/boot-results.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5b46cdad0e5c`.

## Top level

| Field     | Type                                                                           | Required | Description |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `results` | array of [tuningBootResult](/reference/schemas/boot-results/#tuningbootresult) | Yes      |             |

## Definitions

### tuningBootOutcome

Type: `"feasible"`, `"infeasible"`

### tuningBootResult

| Field            | Type                                                                    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `knobs`          | [tuningKnobSet](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobset)         | Yes      | The knob set that was booted. servtuner propose rejects an empty one: it would match every configuration.                                                                |
| `outcome`        | [tuningBootOutcome](/reference/schemas/boot-results/#tuningbootoutcome) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `reason`         | `string`                                                                | No       | Why it did not boot: the last log lines or the exit reason.                                                                                                              |
| `c_kv`           | `number`                                                                | No       | The concurrency the KV cache can hold, from num\_gpu\_blocks in vllm:cache\_config\_info; for a feasible boot. ≥ 0                                                       |
| `num_gpu_blocks` | `integer`                                                               | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `kv_sizing`      | [tuningKvSizing](/reference/schemas/boot-results/#tuningkvsizing)       | No       |                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `vllm_version`   | `string`                                                                | No       | vLLM's version as its /version reported it, for a feasible boot. A tuning session reusing this boot on a host checks it against the version the host's launcher reports. |

### tuningKvSizing

How vLLM's extensible KV cache was sized at boot (vLLM 0.34+), read from its log lines `Free memory on device ... on startup` and `Memory after warmup ...`. GiB values are as vLLM logged them, to 0.01 GiB.

| Field                   | Type                        | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bound`                 | `"memory"`, `"utilization"` | Yes      | Which limit sized the cache: `utilization` when gpu\_memory\_utilization x total memory was the smaller, `memory` when the memory free after warmup (less vLLM's margin) was. Under `memory`, a higher gpu\_memory\_utilization gives no more KV cache. |
| `kv_cache_gib`          | `number`                    | Yes      | The KV cache vLLM committed. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `requested_gib`         | `number`                    | Yes      | gpu\_memory\_utilization x total memory. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `memory_limit_gib`      | `number`                    | No       | The free-memory limit before the transient reserve: free after warmup plus committed, less the margin.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `utilization_limit_gib` | `number`                    | No       | The gpu\_memory\_utilization limit before the transient reserve: requested less what vLLM uses besides the cache.                                                                                                                                       |
